article.title: The world order beyond polarity: The Forty-Third Newsletter (2026)
article.author: Vijay Prashad
article.content: The relative decline of Washington’s unipolar command creates vital geopolitical openings, yet shifting centres of power do not by themselves dismantle the corporate monopolies that shape international finance, technology, and production. The post The world order beyond polarity: The Forty-Third Newsletter (2026) appeared first on MR Online .
